name: Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and dry the 4 cups chopped romaine and place in a large salad bowl.
Add the 2/3 cup diced bell pepper, 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, 3/4 cup diced cucumber, 3/4 cup chickpeas.
In a small jar, shake together the 1 tablespoon olive oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1/4 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt until emulsified.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is lightly coated. Serve right away.
